description: This Java class 'LoanCOBPartitioner' implements the 'Partitioner' interface for batch processing in Spring Batch. It creates data partitions for processing loan-related COB (Close of Business) operations, retrieving loan IDs, managing job execution, and logging partitioning details.

classes.name: LoanCOBPartitioner
classes.description: A batch partitioner class for creating loan COB processing partitions, managing job execution, and logging partition details.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Creates a map of partition names to execution contexts based on the grid size.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Generates partitions based on loan data, creating at least one if none are found.

methods.name: getLoanCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of loans across partitions.

methods.name: createNewPartition
methods.description: Creates an execution context for a specific loan partition.

methods.name: stopJobExecution
methods.description: Stops any running job executions related to the loan COB process.
